intended_use: Optional geometry context for inspection positioning and scene documentation only.
planned_spatial_tasks: Geometry evidence kept separate from substance-related evidence
limitations_and_safety_boundaries: LiDAR/depth geometry cannot identify narcotics or infer chemical composition.

Chemical/X-ray modalities require lawful, validated equipment and separately verified evidence.
evidence_status: No real sensor integration, substance detection performance, field validation or certification claimed.
cost_policy: standard-library-first; no paid APIs, cloud GPU, model downloads or hardware purchases
